'''Theepa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] performer.

In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], the [[Grand Coruscant Theatre]] presented her [[Hyperdrive Tour]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
